description: The account's conversations, newest activity first: status (open, pending, snoozed or resolved, open by default), inbox_id to narrow it to one inbox, and page, 1 upwards. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /chatwoot/v1/connections/{connection_id}/conversations, group chatwoot.

connection_id.description: Value for the {connection_id} segment of /chatwoot/v1/connections/{connection_id}/conversations. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
